text:
Ava T.: FYI the onboarding quickstart surfaces opaque errors when token refresh fails. We need clearer shapes so product code can decide retry vs reauth.

Diego R.: Seen that. Right now SDK emits plain Error with a long stack. No stable code or retry hint. Breaking for frontend UX.

Nora S.: Can we define a minimal error contract first? Suggest fields: `code` (stable string), `http_status`, `retry_hint` (one of 'none'|'retry_after'|'maybe'), `human_message`, `details` (dev text).

Ava T.: Love it. Example codes: `auth_invalid`, `auth_expired`, `rate_limited`, `client_bad_request`, `conflict`, `server_error`, `network_transient`.

Diego R.: For 429 we should prefer `retry_after` header if present. If absent maybe return `retry_hint: maybe` and include a recommended backoff in `details`.

Nora S.: SDK implementation pattern: base RedwoodError + subclasses per code. JS: throw. Py: raise. Also expose `.toJSON()` / `to_dict()` so sample apps can stringify safely.

Ava T.: Quick UX guidance: `human_message` should be <=60 chars and actionable: e.g. "Session expired — sign in again." or "Rate limit hit, try again in a few seconds." Put request_id and raw server message in `details`.

Diego R.: Telemetry: please emit `error.code` and `http_status` as structured fields. Current logs only include message text which makes detection flaky.

ci-bot: CI started for branch `chore/error-contract`  1 job queued.

Nora S.: Tests: unit tests for mapping table, integration test stubbing 401/429/503, and sample app e2e to ensure UI shows `human_message`.

Ava T.: Docs: can we add a canonical mapping table and a tiny JSON example per code? e.g. { "code":"auth_expired","http_status":401,"human_message":"Session expired","retry_hint":"none","details":"refresh token invalid" }

docs-bot: created docs ticket `docs/error-contracts` (#421).

Diego R.: I'll prototype the JS error classes and a `fromResponse(resp)` mapper that reads headers. Nora, can you own Python?

Nora S.: Yep, I'll take Python and update the `examples/quickstart` to consume `human_message`.

Ava T.: Great. I'll add the sprint card and add acceptance criteria: stable codes, telemetry fields, docs mapping, sample app updated, tests.

Diego R.: small follow-up: include guidance on when to surface `human_message` vs `dev_message` (UI vs logs). Keep `human_message` friendly and short.

Ava T.: Noted. Thanks team, keeping this thread to track owners.
